title: RJL Painting Alternative for Warehouses & Garage Floors
description: Comparing RJL Painting with Precision Paint Experts for a warehouse, shop, or garage floor coating? What to ask about scheduling, prep, and coating systems.
h1: RJL Painting vs. Precision Paint Experts
heroIntro: Industrial walls and concrete floors take more abuse than any living room. Here is how to compare coating proposals for warehouses, shops, and garages.

sections.h2: A comparison built around hard-use surfaces
body: RJL Painting is one of the painting companies that business owners and homeowners in North Central Florida may be comparing with Precision Paint Experts. We do not make statements about other contractors. This page covers two kinds of work where the coating spec and schedule decide the outcome: warehouse and industrial painting, and concrete floor coatings for garages and shops.
Forklift traffic, hot tires, chemical spills, and dock doors that stay open all day put coatings under very different stress than a bedroom wall. The questions you ask should reflect that.

For commercial properties, the biggest question is often when the work can happen. Precision Paint Experts schedules commercial work around operating hours, including nights and weekends, so production or shipping can continue. A certificate of insurance naming your entity is available before mobilization.

Our warehouse and industrial painting service covers interior and exterior surfaces, and concrete and masonry painting handles block and concrete walls. For buildings that attract tagging, anti-graffiti coatings make cleanup simpler.

Industrial projects usually need more coordination than a home repaint. Racking, inventory, and equipment may need to be cleared or covered, loading areas may need to stay open, and safety rules on site have to be followed. The walkthrough is the time to agree on those details, and the estimate is where they should be written down so supervisors and crews are working from the same plan. Commercial exterior work follows the same seasonal guidance as homes, with October through May the easiest window.

Floor coatings fail most often because of the concrete underneath: moisture, contamination, or inadequate surface prep. Our article on why garage floor epoxy peels explains the usual causes. We install both epoxy and polyaspartic systems through our garage floor coating service, and the estimate states which system and what preparation are included.

Homeowners often ask about floors in the same breath as walls. A garage that doubles as a workshop or a gym takes heavy loads and frequent cleaning, and the right coating system depends on how the space is used. Our crew lead will ask about vehicles, tools, and traffic during the walkthrough, and take moisture readings where needed, so the recommendation fits the slab you actually have. Our epoxy floor installation page covers the process in more detail.

sections.h2: Questions for any industrial or floor coating bid
body: Whoever bids, ask for these in writing:
bullets: Which coating system is specified for each surface?
How will concrete be prepared and tested for moisture?
Can work be scheduled outside operating hours?
Is a certificate of insurance naming our company provided before start?
Are crews in-house or subcontracted, and covered by workers' comp?

body: We are licensed, bonded, and fully insured in Florida, with workers' comp on every crew member, and we use our own crews. The itemized estimate lists surfaces, prep, products, coats, and schedule, and nothing is added without written approval. Request a free estimate for your facility or garage.

faqs.q: Do you work nights and weekends on commercial jobs?
faqs.a: Yes. Commercial work is scheduled around operating hours, including nights and weekends.

faqs.q: Do you install polyaspartic as well as epoxy?
faqs.a: Yes. We offer both garage floor epoxy and polyaspartic coatings, and the estimate names the system chosen.

faqs.a: Yes. A certificate naming your entity is available before mobilization.
